summary: Validated PATCH typing refactor for CleanTec backend. Extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with 16 new tests covering PatchClienteIn, PatchArticoloIn, PatchMacchinaIn, PatchConsegnaIn, PatchLavorazioneIn, PatchNonConformitaIn, PatchFatturaIn, PatchUserIn. Ran full suite — 50/50 passed (34 regression + 16 new).
critical_code_review_comments: schemas.py: `from pydantic import ConfigDict` is placed mid-file (line 126) with `# noqa: E402` — acceptable but would be cleaner to consolidate imports at top.

PatchConsegnaIn/PatchFatturaIn still use Dict[str, Any] for `geolocation` / `righe` items. Acceptable since top-level typing refactor is the main goal, but a follow-up could introduce Geolocation and RigaFattura schemas for full type safety.
Behavioral auto-sets (data_consegna_effettiva, inizio, fine) confirmed working via dedicated tests after the typing refactor.
seed_data_creation: No seed data changes. Tests create TEST_-prefixed ephemeral records (clienti, consegne, lavorazioni, fatture, nc, 1 user) and clean up the user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full backend regression baseline is 50 tests. For iteration 3 the PATCH typing refactor is validated: empty body -> 200, unknown fields -> silently ignored (extra='ignore'), invalid types -> 422, behavioral side-effects (data_consegna_effettiva on consegna=consegnata; inizio on lavorazione=in_corso; fine on lavorazione=completato; bcrypt hashing on user password PATCH) all preserved. No backend issues found.
rca of the issue: N/A — refactor validated cleanly, no defects observed.
